card.name: Linking words before a named drug or therapy
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, to, with and commas right before a drug or treatment name, in dosing and transition sections. Also the section number inside a cross-reference like (2.7).

modes.label: Of/to before a drug
modes.description: The word of or to sits right before a named drug or therapy phase.
modes.example: The initial dose<< of>> Treprostinil Injection should be the

modes.label: With or comma in regimens
modes.description: A comma or with sits inside a combination regimen, before the next agent.
modes.example: Nilotinib capsules may be given in combination<< with>> hematopoietic growth factors, such

modes.label: Section cross-references
modes.description: A number or space inside a bracketed Dosage and Administration section reference.
